game_concept: A action defense set in Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market, a forest mushroom market: the fairy gardener must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Iteration Tracer: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market: a forest mushroom market
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Market, repeat each round: Predict how many times a loop body runs before the clock stops. Each round, giant beetles strike the waterfall gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the trace_score value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the waterfall gate from giant beetles in Mushroom Market: keep the trace_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 48-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: trace_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 48-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Iteration Tracer
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Iteration Tracer' (Week 5 slot 12), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Mushroom Market'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Mushroom Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 48 seconds while trace_score > 0.
